note: The voices a user can pick at intake (D-71). Each has one sample reading the same line, made by scripts/voice-samples.mjs into tts/samples/. ElevenLabs voices show only when the project has an ElevenLabs key; free voices always. house: the recommended voice for that gender (ElevenLabs Rachelle and Killian when a key is present; otherwise Mary and James). Notes are audition verdicts (2026-11-01), in plain words for the user.
